summary: GoldenEye entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: GoldenEye 007
entries.definitive_edition: Xbox rerelease for campaign/local play; Switch Online only for online multiplayer

emulation.notes: N64 hardware or verified personal emulation only for exact-original comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Xbox rerelease for modern fidelity; original N64 for hardware authenticity

primary.why: The Xbox rerelease is the current official high-fidelity route, with improved resolution/control options and achievements. The Nintendo Switch Online route has the key online-multiplayer advantage, so use it only as a secondary route for that feature.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Xbox version through Game Pass/Rare Replay for the main campaign and local multiplayer route. Record platform, resolution mode, control scheme, achievement state, cheats, difficulty, and whether Switch Online multiplayer was separately tested.

secondary.exclusive_content: Online multiplayer wrapper for the Nintendo 64 version.
secondary.what_to_play: Use Switch Online only to document online multiplayer if that matters to the archive.
secondary.why: Online multiplayer is a Switch-version advantage, while Xbox emphasizes fidelity/control/achievements.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Rare/Nintendo cartridge and controller route.
all_releases.reason: skip: historical control/display route; use only for exact N64 authenticity.

all_releases.fidelity: Official N64 emulation route with online multiplayer through Nintendo Switch Online.
all_releases.reason: secondary: online multiplayer route absent from Xbox.

all_releases.fidelity: Official modern route with improved resolution/control options and achievements.
all_releases.reason: primary: best current fidelity route for campaign/local play.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Xbox is the fidelity route, but Switch Online is the official online-multiplayer route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record control scheme and do not confuse the 2010 GoldenEye reboot or cancelled XBLA remaster with this 1997 game.
